subject: general
question:
There are four underlined words in the sentence given below. One of them is misspelt. Choose the option with the misspelt word.

The Royal Academy urges __governerce__ for data centres to report energy, water use, and carbon __emissions__, ensuring __accountable__ AI __deployments__.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. governerce .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"governerce"** is incorrectly spelled in the given sentence.
 
• The correct spelling is **"governance"**, which refers to the process or system of controlling and managing a country, organization, or institution.
 
• All other words in the options, i.e., "emissions," "accountable," and "deployments," are spelled correctly.

Correct sentence: *The Royal Academy urges governance for data centres to report energy, water use, and carbon emissions, ensuring accountable AI deployments.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Spelling mistakes are common in written communication, and they can change the meaning or reduce the clarity of a sentence.
 
• It is important to carefully proofread your writing or use spell-check tools to ensure accuracy, particularly for formal or professional communication.
